name: Exit (loading zone)
description: Taken when the player enters its radius (or crosses its plane): loads the target level at a start point. MSR mod #6, 'How levels link'.

fields.name: levelHigh
fields.description: target level, high byte; 0xFF = the low byte alone

fields.name: startPoint
fields.description: start point in the target level

fields.name: condition
fields.description: 0-24: game-flag tests; 3 = not in the power suit, 4 = power suit only

fields.name: animGroup
fields.description: animation group for the next level, -1 none
